_comment: Question set for capacity (ICE) events. Option keys must match internal/core/decision/types.go (checked by questions_test.go). target_region is added at request time from region_choices.

ice_kind.instructions: What kind of launch failure is described in ev?

criteria.capacity: the cloud has no free instances of the requested type right now
criteria.quota: an account or service limit such as vCPU or spot quota was hit
criteria.config: a misconfiguration such as permissions, AMI, subnet or launch template
criteria.unknown: none of the above or not enough information

transient.instructions: Will a short wait and retry in the same region likely succeed?

action.instructions: What should the scheduler do about the pending replicas in the home region?

criteria.wait_and_retry: keep the demand here and let the provisioner retry
criteria.fallback_in_region: stay in the region but allow other capacity types or instance types
criteria.shift_to_other_region: raise replicas in another region that has room
criteria.escalate: no safe automatic action; notify a human

urgency.instructions: How urgent is acting on this?

target_region.instructions: If load moves, which region should receive it?
